name: JTF_RS_REP_MANAGERS_SS
description: Snapshot table used to temporarily store the reporting hierarchy.

columns.name: DENORM_MGR_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for denorm record

columns.name: TREE_STRUCTURE_CODE
columns.description: Tree structure code of the resource organization hierarchy. FK to FND_TREE_STRUCTURE.TREE_STRUCTURE_CODE

columns.name: TREE_CODE
columns.description: Tree code of the resource organization hierarchy. FK to FND_TREE.TREE_CODE

columns.name: TREE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Tree version id of the resource organization hierarchy. FK to FND_TREE_VERSION.TREE_VERSION_ID

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the resource member party. Foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES.PARTY_ID.

columns.name: GROUP_ID
columns.description: The group identifier to which this record refers to

columns.name: HIERARCHY_TYPE
columns.description: the hierarchy type ( refers to fnd_lookups where looup type is JTF_RS_HIERARCHY

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REPORTS_TO_FLAG
columns.description: This flag indicates whether the resource is directly reporting to the manager

columns.name: START_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Active Start date of the Relation

columns.name: END_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Active End date od Relation

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PAR_ROLE_RELATE_ID
columns.description: The role relation Identifier of the manager record

columns.name: CHILD_ROLE_RELATE_ID
columns.description: The Role Relate Identifier of the member

columns.name: PARENT_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: The resource id of the manager

columns.name: DENORM_LEVEL
columns.description: Column to show the depth of the hierarchy

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).

columns.name: CPDRF_VER_SOR
columns.description: Cross Pillar Data Replication Framework (CPDRF) system column for tracking record version in System of Record (SOR) pillar when a  record change is replicated to subscribing pillars by the replication flows.

columns.name: CPDRF_VER_PILLAR
columns.description: Cross Pillar Data Replication Framework (CPDRF) system column for tracking record version when a record is changed by replication flows

columns.name: CPDRF_LAST_UPD
columns.description: Cross Pillar Data Replication Framework (CPDRF) system column for tracking source pillar name when a record is changed by the replication flows.

columns.name: PARENT_ORG_ID
columns.description: The organization identifier to which the parent resource refers to
